en.apps.hint.excludeHistory: Excluded apps keep their current values and card UI when history is applied. Shared window layout restores the saved order and sizes. Changing exclusions starts a new history from the current workspace.
en.apps.value.noApp: No app here. Drag one in from the App List, or choose a window in the window layout below to make a new one.
en.apps.value.noLayout: Not set: it opens as its main window alone.
en.apps.value.chooseToMake: Choose a window to make an app of it.
en.apps.status.cleared: The app's window layout is taken away.
en.apps.status.taken: The app's windows are now that window's.
en.apps.status.notApp: That window cannot be an app.
en.apps.status.otherType: A built-in app's main window is its own type ({type}).
en.apps.confirm.remove: Remove "{name}"? Its open windows stay, as plain frames.
en.apps.hint: Of a built-in app only the colour and the window layout can be changed; it keeps them beside it, and "back to the default" takes them away. Your own apps are fixed copies. Name, icon and colour reach every open window of the app at once; the window layout is how it opens next time.
